import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long mo1 = 998244353;
    static final long mo2 = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int[] a = new int[15], b = new int[15], dif = new int[15];
    static int ans;
    static int[] q1 = new int[1000010], q2 = new int[1000010];
    static long[] sq2 = new long[1000010];

    static long dig(int[] b, int l) {
        long re = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= l; i++) {
            re = re * 10 + b[i];
        }
        return re;
    }

    static long Rank(int[] b, int l) {
        long ans = 0;
        for (int di = 1; di <= a[0]; di++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= Math.min(l, di); i++) {
                for (int j = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0); j < b[i]; j++) {
                    long numl = 0, numr = 0;
                    for (int p = 1; p < i; p++) {
                        numl = numr = numl * 10 + b[p];
                    }
                    numl = numr = numl * 10 + j;
                    for (int p = i + 1; p <= di; p++) {
                        numl = numl * 10;
                        numr = numr * 10 + 9;
                    }
                    if (numr > n) numr = n;
                    if (numl <= numr) {
                        ans += numr - numl + 1;
                    }
                }
            }
            if (di <= l) ans++;
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static int F(int[] a, int di) {
        long res = ((-dig(a, di) + Rank(a, di)) % mo1 + mo1) % mo1;
        return (int) res;
    }

    static void dfs(int t, int ed, int[] q, long v) {
        if (t == ed) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
                q[++q[0]] = (int)((v + 1L * i * dif[t]) % mo1);
            }
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= 9; i++) {
            dfs(t + 1, ed, q, (v + 1L * i * dif[t]) % mo1);
        }
    }

    static void update(int di, int i, int j) {
        System.arraycopy(a, 1, b, 1, a[0]);
        b[i] = j;
        for (int p = i + 1; p <= di; p++) b[p] = 0;
        int bas = F(b, di);
        for (int p = i + 1; p <= di; p++) {
            b[p] = 1;
            dif[p] = (int)((F(b, di) + mo1 - bas) % mo1);
            b[p] = 0;
        }
        if (di - i == 0) {
            ans = (int)((ans + bas) % mo2);
            return;
        }
        if (di - i == 1) {
            for (int p = 0; p <= 9; p++) {
                ans = (int)((ans + (bas + 1L * p * dif[di]) % mo1) % mo2);
            }
            return;
        }
        int mid = (di + i) / 2;
        q1[0] = 0;
        q2[0] = 0;
        dfs(i + 1, mid, q1, bas);
        dfs(mid + 1, di, q2, 0);
        Arrays.sort(q2, 1, q2[0] + 1);
        long sq2Sum = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= q2[0]; i++) {
            sq2Sum = (sq2Sum + q2[i]) % mo2;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= q1[0]; i++) {
            int p = Arrays.binarySearch(q2, 1, q2[0] + 1, (int)(mo1 - q1[i]));
            if (p < 0) p = -p - 1;
            ans = (int)((ans + sq2Sum + 1L * q2[0] * q1[i]) % mo2);
            ans = (int)((ans + 1L * (q2[0] - p + 1) * (mo2 - mo1)) % mo2);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        long m = n;
        a[0] = 0;
        while (m > 0) {
            a[++a[0]] = (int)(m % 10);
            m /= 10;
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= a[0] / 2; i++) {
            int temp = a[i];
            a[i] = a[a[0] - i + 1];
            a[a[0] - i + 1] = temp;
        }
        for (int di = 1; di <= a[0]; di++) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= di; i++) {
                int l = (i == 1 ? 1 : 0);
                int r = (di == a[0] ? a[i] - 1 : 9);
                for (int j = l; j <= r; j++) {
                    if (j != a[i]) {
                        update(di, i, j);
                    }
                }
            }
            ans = (int)((ans + F(a, di)) % mo2);
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
